_about: English meaning of every field slug a Vietnamese document pairs. Keyed by the slug `pipeline/kie.py::slug()` derives from the printed caption. Written to be read by a model that has never seen a Vietnamese invoice: it says what the value IS and who issues it, not what the caption says -- the caption is already in `key_text`, and repeating it is what the fallback does.
_by_kind_about: English meaning keyed by the `data-kind` a `generators/html/sheets/*.py` family writes on the element. This is the CLOSED half of the vocabulary -- code emits it, so a new document type reuses it -- and it is the floor a field falls to when its printed caption is one no glossary entry names. `rulebase/kie_glossary.py` tries the slug table first.

_by_kind.caption.figure: Caption printed under an illustration, naming what the picture shows.
_by_kind.caption.table: Caption printed above or below a table, naming what the table lists.
_by_kind.clause.body: Body text of one numbered clause of an agreement or regulation.
_by_kind.clause.head: Heading of one numbered clause -- the words that name what the clause governs.
_by_kind.colhdr: Column heading of the item table: the caption every cell in that column answers to.
_by_kind.colnum: Bracketed column number printed under the column headings, the convention Vietnamese accounting forms use so a later line can cite a column by number.
_by_kind.entry.title: The title of an article listed in this periodical's contents; the value is the standfirst summarising it. This is editorial text, not a form field.
_by_kind.footer: Line printed along the foot of the sheet: software credit, page mark or the copy's distribution note.
_by_kind.footnote: Note keyed to a mark in the body text and printed at the foot of the sheet.
_by_kind.formula: Mathematical expression printed inline, as a calculation the document states rather than a value it reports.
_by_kind.invoice.checks.answer: Answer ticked or written against one question in a checklist block.
_by_kind.invoice.checks.question: One question of a checklist block, the caption whose answer sits beside it.
_by_kind.invoice.field: A labelled header field whose printed caption names no narrower kind in this vocabulary; the widest labelled-pair kind the engine emits.
_by_kind.invoice.field.label: A labelled field in the document's header block: the caption printed to the left or above, and the value beside it. Vietnamese business documents carry most of their identifying data this way rather than in a table.
_by_kind.invoice.number.label: The document's own reference number, printed in the header where a reader looks first to cite the paper.
_by_kind.invoice.words: An amount written out in Vietnamese words; Vietnamese accounting practice repeats the figure in words so it cannot be altered.
_by_kind.invoice.words.label: The invoice total written out in Vietnamese words, printed beneath the figures. Vietnamese accounting practice requires it so a digit cannot be altered after issue.
_by_kind.legal.basis: One citation in the legal-basis block: the decree, circular or decision the document is issued under.
_by_kind.masthead: National heading printed at the top of a state document, the first of the two lines Vietnamese official style requires.
_by_kind.masthead.motto: The motto line under the national heading -- the second of the two lines Vietnamese official style requires.
_by_kind.menu.detail: Continuation text of a table line, printed as a full-width row under the line it belongs to.
_by_kind.menu.discount.label: A reduction applied at the till: a promotion, a member's discount, or a rounding-down of the amount due.
_by_kind.meta.label: A field of document metadata -- a date, a place, a form code or a series symbol -- printed in the margin or masthead rather than in the body.
_by_kind.meta.value: The value of a document-metadata field in the margin -- date, place, form code or serial; the widest metadata kind the engine emits.
_by_kind.note: A free-standing note printed outside any labelled field, addressed to whoever reads the sheet.
_by_kind.parties.title: The heading naming one side of the transaction, above that party's own name, address and tax code.
_by_kind.period: The span of time the document reports on, printed as its own run rather than as a labelled field.
_by_kind.photo.placeholder: The box reserved for a pasted photograph on an identity form; the word printed inside it, not a photograph.
_by_kind.photo.size: Size of the photograph the reserved box expects, printed inside the box in centimetres.
_by_kind.section: Heading that divides the sheet into numbered sections, the roman-numeral heads Vietnamese forms use.
_by_kind.section.body: Body text belonging to one numbered section of the document.
_by_kind.section.head: The words naming what one numbered section covers, printed beside its number.
_by_kind.section.number: The numeral or roman numeral of a section heading, printed as its own run.
_by_kind.recipients: One line of the distribution list printed left of the signature row ("- Như trên;", "- Lưu: VT, TCHC."): a body the document is sent to, or where the original is filed. Nobody signs here.
_by_kind.recipients.label: The printed caption "Nơi nhận:" that opens the distribution list left of the signature row.
_by_kind.sidebar.label: A field printed in the narrow rail beside the main body, where the layout puts reference data the reader scans rather than reads.
_by_kind.sign.name: Printed name of a person who signs, set under the ruled signature line.
_by_kind.sign.note: Note printed inside a signature block -- what the signer is asked to add by hand, or who keeps that copy.
_by_kind.sign.signedat: Place and date printed above a signature block, the line Vietnamese documents open every signature panel with.
_by_kind.sign.title: The role of a person who signs the document, printed above the ruled signature line. The value is that person's name or, on a blank form, the space left for it.
_by_kind.store.account.label: Bank account of the issuing business that the payment should reach.
_by_kind.store.address: Street address of the issuing business, as registered.
_by_kind.store.address.label: Street address of the issuing business, as registered.
_by_kind.store.branch: The branch or outlet of the issuing business where the transaction took place.
_by_kind.store.branch.label: The branch or outlet of the issuing business where the transaction took place.
_by_kind.store.name: Trading name of the business that issued the document.
_by_kind.store.name.label: Trading name of the business that issued the document.
_by_kind.store.phone: Contact telephone number of the issuing business.
_by_kind.store.phone.label: Contact telephone number of the issuing business.
_by_kind.store.tax_code: Vietnamese tax identification number of the issuing business, ten or thirteen digits.
_by_kind.store.tax_code.label: Vietnamese tax identification number of the issuing business, ten or thirteen digits, issued by the tax authority.
_by_kind.store.website: Web address of the issuing business, printed in the letterhead.
_by_kind.subhead.label: A heading dividing the page into sections; the value is the text that heading introduces.
_by_kind.subtitle: Line printed under the document title: the form number, the legal instrument, or the period the title covers.
_by_kind.summary.gross: The gross figure of the closing summary block, before the deductions listed under it.
_by_kind.summary.label: A figure in the closing summary block, restating one number the body of the document already established.
_by_kind.survey.answer: The answer written or ticked against one question of a questionnaire.
_by_kind.survey.cell: One cell of a questionnaire grid, where a row's question meets a column's option.
_by_kind.survey.char: One character written into its own box on a comb field, the per-character boxes Vietnamese forms use for codes.
_by_kind.survey.colhdr: Column heading of a questionnaire grid: the option every cell in that column stands for.
_by_kind.survey.number: The number of one question in a questionnaire, printed beside the question itself.
_by_kind.survey.option: One choice offered for a question, printed beside the box that selects it.
_by_kind.survey.prompt: The words asking for one entry on a form, shorter than a full question and printed against the space for the answer.
_by_kind.survey.question: The full text of one question in a questionnaire.
_by_kind.survey.rowhdr: Row heading of a questionnaire grid: the question every cell in that row answers.
_by_kind.survey.tick: The tick box itself, printed either empty or marked, whose state is the answer.
_by_kind.title: The title of the document, the largest line on the sheet and the words a reader names the paper by.
_by_kind.toc.page: Page number a contents entry points at.
_by_kind.toc.title: The heading one contents entry stands for.
_by_kind.total.grand: The final amount payable, after every tax, discount and surcharge above it.
_by_kind.total.grand.label: The final amount payable, after every tax, discount and surcharge on the summary above it.
_by_kind.total.group: The caption of a subtotal that closes one group of table lines.
_by_kind.total.group_amount: The subtotal figure closing one group of table lines.
_by_kind.total.line: One component of the money summary -- a sub-total, a tax line, a discount or a surcharge.
_by_kind.total.line.label: One component of the money summary -- a sub-total, a tax line, a discount or a surcharge -- named on the left with its amount on the right.
_by_kind.watermark: Text printed faint and large across the sheet, stating the copy's status rather than its content.

_by_path_about: English meaning keyed by the `data-path` a run declares -- the document-specific identity of a field, the other half of the pair `data-kind` opens. This is the CLOSED path vocabulary: the paths `agent/prompts/page.md` teaches, plus the leaves measured dominant across `data/*/declared/*.json`. A path outside it is not mapped to the nearest entry here -- it falls to Semi-open or Staging; see `synthgen/field_tier.py`. Repeat indices are written `[]`: `line_items[0].name` and `line_items[7].name` are one key, because they are one field printed many times.

_by_path.clauses[].head: Heading naming what one clause governs.
_by_path.clauses[].number: Number of one clause of the agreement.
_by_path.customer.address: Address of the person or organisation the document is addressed to.
_by_path.customer.dob: Date of birth of the addressee.
_by_path.customer.email: Contact e-mail address of the addressee.
_by_path.customer.gender: Gender of the addressee as recorded on this document.
_by_path.customer.id_number: Identity-card or citizen-identification number of the addressee.
_by_path.customer.name: Name of the person or organisation the document is addressed to.
_by_path.customer.occupation: Occupation of the addressee as recorded on this document.
_by_path.customer.position: Position the addressee holds in their organisation.
_by_path.customer.representative: Person signing on behalf of the addressee organisation.
_by_path.customer.tax_code: Vietnamese tax identification number of the addressee.
_by_path.document.code: Form code of the template this document is an instance of.
_by_path.document.currency: Currency every amount on the document is stated in.
_by_path.document.date: Date printed on the document when it declares only one.
_by_path.document.effective_date: Date from which the document takes effect.
_by_path.document.expiry_date: Date the document stops being valid.
_by_path.document.location: Place the document was drawn up, the half of the Vietnamese dateline that names a town.
_by_path.document.number: The document's own reference number, the string a later paper cites it by.
_by_path.document.period: The span of time the document reports on.
_by_path.document.reference_number: Number of an earlier document this one answers or amends.
_by_path.document.subtitle: Line under the title: form number, legal instrument, or the period covered.
_by_path.document.title: Title printed on the document.
_by_path.issuer.account: Bank account number the issuing organisation is paid into.
_by_path.issuer.address: Registered address of the issuing organisation.
_by_path.issuer.bank: Bank holding the issuing organisation's account.
_by_path.issuer.branch: Branch or outlet of the issuing organisation that handled this document.
_by_path.issuer.code: Internal code identifying the issuing organisation.
_by_path.issuer.email: Contact e-mail address of the issuing organisation.
_by_path.issuer.name: Legal name of the organisation that issued this document.
_by_path.issuer.phone: Contact telephone of the issuing organisation.
_by_path.issuer.superior: The body the issuing organisation reports to, printed above its own name in Vietnamese official style.
_by_path.issuer.tax_code: Vietnamese tax identification number of the issuing organisation.
_by_path.issuer.website: Web address of the issuing organisation.
_by_path.line_items[].amount: Line amount: quantity multiplied by unit price, before tax.
_by_path.line_items[].code: Item or material code identifying the goods on this line.
_by_path.line_items[].date: Date this line item was issued or incurred.
_by_path.line_items[].description: Fuller description of what this line covers, beyond its name.
_by_path.line_items[].id: Identifier of the thing this line is about, distinct from its name.
_by_path.line_items[].name: Name of the goods or service listed on this line.
_by_path.line_items[].qty: Quantity of the item on this line.
_by_path.line_items[].ref: Reference this line points at -- an earlier document, a contract or a voucher.
_by_path.line_items[].status: State this line is in at the moment the document is drawn up.
_by_path.line_items[].stt: Row ordinal within the item table, counted across the whole document.
_by_path.line_items[].type: Category this line belongs to within the table.
_by_path.line_items[].unit: Unit of measure for the quantity on this line.
_by_path.line_items[].unit_price: Price of one unit of this item, before tax.
_by_path.line_items[].vat_amount: Value-added tax charged on this line.
_by_path.line_items[].vat_rate: Value-added tax rate applied to this line.
_by_path.signers[].name: Printed name of a person who signs the document.
_by_path.signers[].note: Note printed inside this signer's block.
_by_path.signers[].role: The side or function a signer represents in this document.
_by_path.signers[].title: The capacity a signer signs in, printed above the ruled line.
